description: This Java class, TaxValidator, provides validation logic for tax-related entities in the Fineract project. It includes methods to validate creation and update payloads for tax components and groups, as well as logic to ensure date overlaps and total percentages are correct.

classes.name: TaxValidator
classes.description: Provides methods to validate tax components and groups, including creation, update, overlap checks, and total percentage validations.

methods.name: validateForTaxComponentCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for creating a new tax component, ensuring required fields are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateForTaxComponentUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for updating a tax component, optionally validating fields if they are present.

methods.name: validateForTaxGroupCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for creating a new tax group, including its components.

methods.name: validateForTaxGroupUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON payload for updating a tax group, including date consistency and component validations.

methods.name: validateTaxGroupEndDateAndTaxComponent
methods.description: Ensures that end dates of tax group mappings are consistent and cannot be modified arbitrarily.

methods.name: validateTaxGroup
methods.description: Validates a TaxGroup object for business rules such as total percentages and overlapping periods.

methods.name: validateTaxComponentForUpdate
methods.description: Validates that a TaxComponent's total percentage is valid after updates.

methods.name: validateStartDate
methods.description: Validates the start date for a tax component or grouping, ensuring it is after existing dates.

methods.name: validateOverlappingComponents
methods.description: Checks that tax components do not have overlapping date ranges within the same group.

methods.name: validateGroupTotal
methods.description: Ensures the sum of applicable percentages for components on a given date do not exceed 100%.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are any validation errors collected.
